items.markdown: To a solution of methyl 2-ethynylbenzoate (600.0 mg, 3.79 mmol), 2-chloro-3-fluoro-4-iodopyridine (1171.5 mg, 4.55 mmol) in MeCN (3 mL) were added TEA (1.6 mL, 11.38 mmol), CuI (144.5 mg, 0.76 mmol) and Pd(PPh3)2Cl2 (266.2 mg, 0.38 mmol). After addition, the mixture was degassed and purged with N2 for 2 mins and then stirred at 85 ℃ for 2 hrs. After cooling to 20 ℃, the reaction solution was poured into water (50 mL) and extracted with EtOAc (25 mL × 3). The combined organic layers were washed with brine (25 mL × 2), dried over Na2SO4, filtered and concentrated under reduced pressure to give a residue.
